scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Find the Roaming Bard, Lalo, who is at (226,123) on the Comodo town map. This is a short distance from the bottom right of the Kafra. After a short conversation with the bard he will request that the player brings him a flower. The flower must be one of the following: | Hinalle | Ment | Aloe | Illusion Flower | Witherless Rose | Singing Flower | Izidor | Frozen Rose
1.short_ru: Найдите Lalo в Comodo (226,123) и выберите один подходящий цветок.

4.original_instruction: After successfully copying the bard's lyrics, he will change your job to Bard . Upon job change, the bard offers to give you a weapon if you have 60 trunks. Each type of trunk gives the player a different weapon. | Trunk : Violin | Solid Trunk or Barren Trunk : Mandolin | Fine Trunk : Lute | Fine Trunk + Job Level 50 : Harp
4.short_ru: Станьте Bard; при желании обменяйте 60 стволов на соответствующий инструмент.
4.short_en: Become a Bard; optionally exchange 60 trunks for the corresponding instrument.
4.full_ru: Правильно повторив текст песни, вы смените профессию на Bard. При смене профессии бард также предлагает оружие, если у вас есть 60 стволов. Вид награды зависит от вида стволов: Trunk — Violin; Solid Trunk или Barren Trunk — Mandolin; Fine Trunk — Lute; Fine Trunk и Job Level 50 — Harp.

reviews.detail: The guide requires exact copying but prints no lyrics or literal menu answers. No answers from Geffen or another source are transplanted.

Snowysnow is explicitly a corequisite, not a reversed prerequisite. Sticky Mucus/Squid Ink remain header summaries without a fabricated second delivery to Lalo. Snowman identity is scoped to this guide.

The job change does not require 60 trunks. Five conditional offers retain separate trunk identities; Fine Trunk at Job Level 50 selects Harp rather than stacking Lute and Harp. Harp ID 1910 comes from this guide HTML link.
One of eight flowers is required; the category has no guessed game ID. Comodo coordinates have no inferred map code/interior coordinate.

requirements.condition: Header cost associated with the Snowysnow corequisite; no additional hand-in to Lalo is stated.
